title: Kansas sues to halt public funding for $160M lagoon resort still without buildings
summary_full: In a significant move, Kansas state officials have filed a lawsuit aimed at halting any further public bond financing for the stalled Derby Shores project, a $160 million lagoon resort. Despite receiving approval four years ago, construction has yet to commence. The suit seeks to prevent new bond payments and mandates a detailed financial report on bonds already issued, raising concerns over taxpayer exposure from the ongoing delays.
